description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/flux_limiter_superbee_D_periodic driven by problems/advection_1d_periodic_superbee.esm (model AdvectionSuperbee), loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4). Exact solution sin(2 pi (x - c t)). The limiter is second-order where it is inactive, but CLIPS at the sin's two smooth extrema, so the OBSERVED order is below 2 and differs between norms (L2 converges faster than Linf, whose extremum-localized error dominates). expected_order/order_tolerance bracket both observed norm orders honestly; the design order (2) is the rule's `order:` tag, the observed order is here.
